sources.publisher: Civilforsvarsstyrelsen / Rigsarkivet; reproduced by Danmarkshistorien / Lex
sources.notes: Transcription of the dated Civil Defence memorandum, from Rigsarkivet's Erik Schultz official papers, M-51. Its introduction confirms distribution to all Danish households. The memorandum defends the administration's planning assumptions; it is not an independent effectiveness study.

sources.title: Final Communiqué — Defence Planning Committee, December 1983
sources.notes: Official text describing the 6–7 December ministerial session. Footnote 1 records Denmark and Greece reserving their positions on paragraph 5, concerning intermediate-range nuclear forces. Evidence of a specific published reservation, not every dispute in the 1982–1988 period.
